title.en: Flash annealing: compress thermal processing into milliseconds

body.zh: Flash Lamp Anneal利用高能闪光快速加热晶圆表层，典型特征是大面积、毫秒级瞬态热过程。
body.en: Flash Lamp Anneal rapidly heats the wafer surface with high-energy flashes, typically providing large-area, Millisecond transient thermal processing.
